messages:
jamie: kicking off staged rollout v1.12.0 -> canary 5% (eu-west) now. change window 14:00-16:00 PST. Deploy-bot posted release notes: https://redwood/release/v1.12.0 :rocket:

deploy-bot: RELEASE v1.12.0 started. targets: canary=5% eu-west. monitor SLOs: latency95, 5xx, embed-quality. tagging rollout id r-3445. :robot_face:

sarah: :eyes: watching the dashboards, will shout if anything crosses thresholds.

ops_lead: quick checklist: smoke tests passing? canary health ok? autoscale warmup happening?

mike: smoke ok, but seeing embed latency 95th jump from 120ms -> 160ms on a small sample in eu-west (last 10m). not huge but visible.

anita: QA ran the new prompt set. found 2/50 cases where embeddings diverged vs baseline (semantic drift). attaching examples.

jamie: thanks. can you paste one example and the raw log snippet?

mike: example: "query: summarize feature X"
expected embedding sim 0.92 -> baseline vector id 1123
current sim 0.68 -> different cluster.

mike: logs:
```
[14:05:12] embed-service eu-west node-7: request_id=abc123 latency=158ms err=null
[14:05:13] embed-service eu-west node-3: request_id=abc124 latency=162ms err=null
[14:05:14] reranker: similarity_score=0.68 for req=abc123
```

anita: impact looks like ranking/recall regression on a narrow prompt family. not universal but reproducible locally.

ops_lead: suggest HOLD at 5% and pin rollout. we need a quick eval run across the critical prompt set and decide rollback vs hotfix.

deploy-bot: ACK. pinning rollout id r-3445 at 5%. traffic will not increase until manual unpin. command: `deploy-bot pin r-3445 --reason "quality-reeval"`

jamie: doing pin now. everyone please acknowledge with :thumbsup: or :no_entry_sign: if you object.

sarah: :thumbsup: run targeted eval, please.

mike: :thumbsup: collecting more samples and traces, will post summary in 10m.

anita: :thumbsup: preparing reproduction steps and minimal failing cases.

eval-bot: queued eval job ev-778 with prompt_set=critical-affordances, expected completion ~8m.

ops_lead: plan B (rollback) ready if eval shows regression across >5% of critical set or if latency/5xx cross thresholds. rollback playbook: `deploy-bot rollback r-3445 --to v1.11.9 --notify customers` (checked).

jamie: agree. notify CS on standby. i'll hold traffic ramp and update release notes with pause note.

deploy-bot: rollout pinned. state=ramped_to_5pct_pinned. audit: jamie pinned at 3445556710.

mike: quick sample summary (prelim): 50 queries, 4 with sim <0.7 vs baseline. not widespread but concentrated on long-form product-describe prompts.

anita: repro steps and a tiny patch candidate ready (diff + tiny tokenizer tweak). want to run A/B test on a single canary node?

ops_lead: prefer hold until eval completes. if eval fails, we execute rollback within window and open incident. if eval passes, we can unpin and warm to 20% after 30m extra monitoring.

jamie: consensus = HOLD. no ramp. ops_lead to greenlight rollback if ev-778 fails. assign: ops_lead exec rollback, mike collect logs, anita prep patch.

ops_lead: acknowledged. setting PagerDuty on-call to standby.

eval-bot: ev-778 done. results: critical-affordances: pass_rate=92% baseline=96% delta=-4pp. flagging as regression per threshold (>=3pp). raw_report: https://redwood/evals/ev-778

mike: that's enough to trigger rollback per playbook.

jamie: prep rollback. deploy-bot, run rollback command when ready. ensure customer notification note drafted: "We paused v1.12.0 canary after quality regression, rolling back to v1.11.9 for stability."

deploy-bot: executing: `deploy-bot rollback r-3445 --to v1.11.9 --notify "cs-team@redwood" --reason "embed-quality-regression"`

deploy-bot: rollback complete. traffic now at v1.11.9. state=rolled_back. audit: rollback by jamie at 3445556820.

ops_lead: postmortem checklist: capture failing prompts, reproduce locally, vet patch, run full eval before reattempt, update release notes. scheduled follow-up meeting at 16:30 PST.

jamie: thanks all. closing rollout for now. will re-open when patch validated. :white_check_mark:
